# Test data sources

These arrays come from other people's work. Each one is checked by the
plain verifier in the tests.

- `CA_42_3_8_3.txt`: the best known CA(42; 3, 8, 3), from the ca-tools
  table by Christopher Smolen
  ([Zenodo 24168009](https://zenodo.org/records/24168009), MIT license).
  The construction is from Colbourn, Kéri, Rivas Soriano and
  Schlage-Puchta, "Covering and radius-covering arrays: Constructions and
  classification", Discrete Applied Mathematics 158 (2010).
- `CA_12_2_7_3.txt`: CA(12; 2, 7, 3) from the same ca-tools table
  (file `CA_12_2_7_3_da606e89.txt`, MIT license).
- `CA_12_2_7_3.kokkala.txt`: CA(12; 2, 7, 3) from Kokkala, Meagher,
  Naserasr, Nurmela, Östergård and Stevens, "Classification of small
  strength-2 covering arrays"
  ([Zenodo 1476059](https://zenodo.org/records/1476059), CC BY 4.0).
- `CA_33_3_6_3.txt`: the unique CA(33; 3, 6, 3), transposed from
  Izquierdo-Marquez and Torres-Jimenez, "New covering array numbers"
  ([arXiv 1711.10040](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10040)).

The ca-tools license is copied in full in
[LICENSE.ca-tools](LICENSE.ca-tools).
